name: Lazaros Lazarou
bio: Lazaros Lazarou received his Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Cyprus in 2025. Since January 2024, he has been an Intern at the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, working on anomaly detection for stealthy attacks in industrial control systems. He is currently a PhD Student in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Cyprus, carrying out his research at KIOS CoE. His research focuses on Cyber-Physical Systems, with a particular emphasis on Post-Quantum Cryptography and fast packet processing in Software-Defined Networks.
shortBio: PhD student researching PQC, fast packet processing in SDN, and CPS security.
